result.summary: Several visual and layout problems: truncated restaurant names, a loading spinner stuck over content, cut-off category chips and cards, and partial bottom content.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards have enough width/ellipsis handling so full names are readable.

issues.description: A large circular loading spinner is overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, blocking the main visual of a featured item.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image has loaded, or show a proper skeleton/placeholder that does not obscure the final content.

issues.description: Category filter chips on the right (after Healthy) are clipped by the screen edge, implying incomplete horizontal scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent end padding and a clearer scroll indicator so users know more categories exist off-screen.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza with -20%) is heavily cropped by the bottom navigation, so most of the item is not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so cards can scroll fully into view above the nav.

issues.description: Fastest near you cards show only partial third card, with harsh crop and no strong peek/fade cue for horizontal scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card peek width and optional edge fade so the carousel scrollability is obvious.
